title: English Practice Quiz 0213
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.
